data.name: Cathi
data.gender_notes: Cathi is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek name 'Katharos', meaning 'pure' or 'clean'. In Greek mythology, Katharos was the name of a river god. In Christianity, 'Cathi' could symbolize the purification of the soul through faith. The name Cathi carries the meaning “Pure, Clean” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Cathi usually hope their child will grow to embody pure, clean and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of spiritual purity and faith.
data.etymology: Cathi belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Pure, Clean.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Cathi total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

in_hebrew.name: קאתי
in_hebrew.long_meaning: השם קאתי הוא נגזר מהשם היווני Αικατερίνη, שפירושו טהורה, ברורה. מקור השם הוא במילה היוונית 'איקאטרינה', שפירושו טהורה. השם קאתי הוא שם נפוץ בקרב הנוצרים, ומשמעותו היא טהורה ונקיה.

in_greek.name: Καθη
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Καθη είναι μια μορφή του ονόματος Αικατερίνη, που σημαίνει την καθαρή και αγία. Η προέλευση του ονόματος είναι από την ελληνική λέξη 'αικατερίνη', που σημαίνει καθαρή. Το όνομα Καθη ήταν δημοφιλές στην αρχαία Ελλάδα και ήταν επίσης ένα από τα ονόματα που δόθηκαν στις γυναίκες που ακολουθούσαν τον Χριστό.

in_latin.name: Cathi
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Cathi derivatur ex nomine Graeco Αικατερίνη, quod significat purus, sancta. Origo nominis est in voce Graeca 'αικατερίνη', quod significat purus. Nomen Cathi est nomen commune inter Christianos, et significat purus et mundus.

in_english.name: Cathi
in_english.long_meaning: The name Cathi is derived from the Greek name Αικατερίνη, meaning pure, clear, and holy. It originates from the Greek word 'αικατερίνη', which signifies purity. Cathi is a common name among Christians, symbolizing spiritual purity and clarity. Historically, the name has been associated with Saint Catherine, a 4th-century martyr and saint in the Christian tradition. The name Cathi conveys a sense of innocence, virtue, and devotion.
